Reconstructed all 99 verses of **علی حق** in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both versions align across the unnumbered preamble and eight numbered stanzas. Updated the title and right-to-left direction and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman forms “Jali” and “Ghaam” as `جلی` and `گام`. Only the selected lyric was edited.
